title: "Teaching"
---

I teach undergraduate and graduate courses in international relations, civil wars, and political violence. If you are a current or prospective student and would like access to syllabi or other materials, please feel free to email me.

## Current & recent courses

-   [**POLI 4040 – Scientific Study of Civil Wars**](files/civil_war_syl_fa_25.pdf)\
    Upper-division course on the life cycle of civil wars, including onset, duration, severity, termination, and recurrence.

-   [**POLI 2057 - Introduction to International Relations**](POL2057-Syllabus-Fa2025_v1 copy.pdf)\
    Large-lecture introduction to core theories of international politics, with an emphasis on war, cooperation, and international institutions.

## Teaching materials

-   Syllabi and selected assignments will be posted here as they become available.
-   I frequently incorporate simulations, games, and data-driven exercises into my classes.
